professionalSummary.text: Examines presented documents against documentary credit terms under the bank's examination standard.
professionalSummary.witness: Trade finance operations specialist at a commercial bank for four years, examining presented documents against documentary credit terms under the bank's examination standard for about six hundred presentations a year.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepares discrepancy notices and payment instructions for the checker's release, with release staying with the checker.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the discrepancy notices and the payment instructions for each presentation for the checker's release; the release was the checker's under the four-eyes rule, recorded against my preparation in the trade system.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Records the checker's decisions in the trade system and keeps the client status report current.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Recorded the checkers' decisions in the trade system and kept the client status report current for the relationship managers each day.

skills.text: Coordinates document queries with the correspondent banks and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated document queries with the correspondent banks' trade desks through the query log, recording which queries I closed and which were referred to the checker.
